_about: Every external source behind the site. Rendered into /accuracy/ by docs/superpowers/tools/data_sources.py. published = the publisher's own last update; checked = when we last confirmed our figures against it; our update is worked out from git history using probe (the first commit that contains the figure as it stands). govuk entries are re-checked automatically against the GOV.UK content API with --check.

assumptions: LPG at 9.5p per kWh is our own assumption for a typical bulk contract; there is no official average.
The EPC estimate is a simple points model, not the government's SAP software, and it has not been compared with lodged certificates.
Solar generation for each region is set a little below the PVGIS figure for its sunniest city, to allow for shading and soiling on real roofs.
Where the Energy Saving Trust publishes no figure we borrow the nearest home: an end-terrace takes the semi-detached cost, and a top floor flat's loft takes the mid-terrace cost.
The typical household bill of £1,723 is the price cap rates applied to Ofgem's typical use of 2,500 kWh of electricity and 9,500 kWh of gas.
